subject: general
question:
**In the following questions a statement has been given with highlighted text. Select the options that can replace the text with correct idiom or phrase.**

The trainee performed the task __**with extreme ease**__.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e. **"A piece of cake".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **With extreme ease: **This means something was done very easily or without any difficulty. (बहुत ही आसानी से) 

 
 
• **Example**: She solved the complicated math problem with extreme ease. 
 
 
 
• **A piece of cake: **(बहुत आसान) - Something that is very easy to do.
 
 
• **Example**: For an experienced chef like him, preparing a gourmet meal is a piece of cake. 
 
 
 
• This idiom suits the context of performing a task easily.

** Therefore, the correct answer is* "A piece of cake".***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Call it a day: **(काम खत्म करना) - To stop what one is doing, often at the end of the day.
 
• ** At the eleventh hour: **(अंतिम समय में) - At the last possible moment or opportunity. 
 
• **Swan song: **(अंतिम कार्य) - A final performance or effort, especially before retirement or death.
